description: This file implements the StreamSplitter class, which manages buffer distribution and synchronization for graphic buffers in Android's graphics system. It handles buffer acquisition from an input, distributes buffers to multiple outputs, and manages buffer release and cleanup.

classes.name: StreamSplitter
classes.description: Manages buffer distribution from an input buffer consumer to multiple output buffer producers, handling synchronization, buffer tracking, and cleanup.

classes.name: StreamSplitter::OutputListener
classes.description: Listens for buffer release events from output buffer producers and triggers buffer release handling in the StreamSplitter.

classes.name: StreamSplitter::BufferTracker
classes.description: Tracks individual buffers, manages fence merging, and reference counting for buffer lifecycle management.

methods.name: createSplitter
methods.description: Creates and initializes a StreamSplitter instance with a given input buffer consumer.

methods.name: addOutput
methods.description: Adds an output buffer producer to the splitter, establishing connection and link to death notifications.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the consumer name for the input buffer queue.

methods.name: onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Handles new frame availability, acquiring buffers, detaching from input, and queuing to outputs.

methods.name: onBufferReleasedByOutput
methods.description: Handles buffer release events from outputs, merging fences, updating reference counts, and returning buffers to input.

methods.name: onAbandonedLocked
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an output is abandoned, disconnecting input and marking the splitter as abandoned.
